observed.facings.png: Three facings at one scale, each on a checkerboard. South: a tall, round, dome-shaped body covered in shaggy olive-brown fur with patches of moss and lichen. A flat, lichen-crusted plate sits low on the front of the head over two heavy-lidded, half-shut eyes. Long pale whisker-hairs fan out over the face. About six stubby, padded legs show below. East: a lower, longer loaf in side profile. The head is on the right, a blunt snout with the same lichen plate and a sleepy eye. Long guard hairs sweep back along the body, and four to five stubby legs are visible. North: the same dome from behind, with a pale fringe of hair hanging at the rear centre. No face or eyes. The hind legs are thick and the inner legs show between them. All three have the same palette and coat.
observed.south.png: Front view at full resolution. A round, fur-covered mound with a flat, mossy brow or snout shelf. Two narrow, drowsy eyes sit under the shelf and no mouth is visible. A spray of long pale whiskers. Six short, columnar legs ending in rounded pads. Painterly fur texture with moss and lichen flecks. Clean alpha.
observed.east.png: Side profile at full resolution. A low, elongated, hump-backed body, longest front to back, with the head at the right. A tapering, blunt snout capped by a lichen plate, and a closed or half-closed eye. Long whiskers and guard hairs stream backward. Four or five short legs with padded feet. Mossy patches on the back. Clean alpha, no ground.
observed.north.png: Rear view at full resolution. A shaggy dome with lichen on top and a vertical tuft or fringe of pale hair at the centre of the rear, like a tail-brush. Two big haunch legs in front, with smaller legs visible behind them. A small green moss patch sits between the legs at the bottom, but it is on the body's underside, not a ground patch. No face.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom the creature stands beside the vanilla cartoon human and fills about half a cell wide and under half a cell tall: a small animal, roughly cat-sized. At normal play (32 px per cell) it is a tiny grey-brown smudge next to the rat, with low contrast against the brown ground.

SOUTH_FRONT.seen: South shows the face toward the camera: the lichen snout plate, two drowsy eyes and the whisker spray, centred over the front legs.

NORTH_REAR.seen: North shows the back dome, a hanging pale tail-fringe and the haunches. No eyes or face.

NO_OVERHEAD.seen: All three facings are at the angled game camera with the legs visible. None is a plan view.

SAME_SIZE.seen: Measured spread is 24%. East (154 px) is visibly lower than south (191) and north (185). Part of that is a pose: the profile body is a long, low loaf, and south's top hairs add height. But the front and rear views show a tall round dome that the low side silhouette does not support, so the body's volume does not quite agree across views.

SAME_ANIMAL.seen: Same coat, lichen plate, whiskers and stubby padded legs on every facing. The snout plate turns correctly: frontal on south, a profile cap on east, absent on north.

SIGNATURE.seen: The description's features read clearly: very round with 'fog-fat', fuzzy, whiskered for navigating by touch, and mossy and stone-like enough to 'become a stone' when still.

ALIEN.seen: Nearest Earth read is a shaggy hedgehog or porcupine, especially in the east profile with its swept-back guard hairs. It departs from that animal with six columnar legs, a flat lichen-crusted head plate with no visible mouth, and a moss-grown coat. A stranger would not name it a hedgehog at first glance.

STYLE.seen: Painterly, realistic fur rendering with a soft dark edge. The drowsy half-lidded eyes give it a slightly endearing look, but it is not glossy-eyed, smiling or cel-shaded.

OURS.seen: This is not any vanilla or known mod animal. The art is bespoke.

ALPHA.seen: Clean cut-out on every facing with no ground, shadow or halo. The green patch at the bottom of north is moss on the body's underside between the legs.

SCALE.seen: About cat-sized beside the human (drawSize 0.8). That fits a small, common runway animal that is 'harder to see'.

LEGIBLE.seen: At 32 px it is a small rounded grey-brown blob with a few leg stubs. It reads as a small animal, but its contrast with brown ground is low. That is fitting for a camouflaged animal, though borderline.

reply.subject: RM_Fuzzrunner
reply.image_seen: The composite and individual sprites show a round, shaggy, lichen-mottled creature from front, side and rear; the scale panel shows its low body beside a human.

concerns.evidence: The south and north bodies have tall domed backs, while the east body has a visibly flattened dome. All three stand on short, planted legs; the east view shows no crouch that explains the measured 24% height spread.

The east silhouette suggests a hedgehog, but its visible anatomy does not resolve into that animal: three stout legs line the near flank, the broad flattened muzzle carries a mineral-like plate, and long whiskers spread across an uninterrupted head-and-body mass. The front view reinforces the unusual broad facial plate and radial whiskers.

request.prompt: RimWorld creature sprite, painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, clean dark outline, transparent background. A fuzzrunner: a round, fog-fat, fuzzy-coated runner of the plains, with a deep rounded barrel torso, short sturdy legs planted beneath it, small alert ears and a whiskered snout used for smelling its way along narrow worn runs under dense canopy. Muted dusty plains-and-canopy palette (grey-browns, dull olive, pale fog-grey fur). It stands with the stillness of a stone, body compact and plump. Four facings share one scale and one standing height. Front view (south): eyes toward the viewer, a tall round dome of back and shoulders above planted legs. Rear view (north): seen from behind, showing back, haunches and tail, eyes hidden, with the same tall round dome as the front. Side view (east): a long body in profile whose back rises in the same tall rounded dome, the top of the back as high above the feet as in the front and rear views, with head and snout pointing forward and legs planted at the same height. The torso volume is equally full and high in every facing, so the silhouette height matches across south, north and east.
